item.title: Cost of Living in Mount Waverley Melbourne
item.description:
Let us talk money in Mount Waverley. Not the median house price headlines - the actual weekly costs of living here.

Read our full Mount Waverley suburb guide for the bigger picture.

Is Mount Waverley Expensive?

Mount Waverley sits somewhere in the middle of Melbourne’s cost spectrum. It’s not cheap, but it’s not going to break the bank either — assuming you’re realistic about expectations.

The cost of living here reflects what the suburb offers. Location, community, access to amenities — you get what you pay for, and in Mount Waverley, you’re generally getting good value for the price point.

item.title: Mount Waverley Neighbourhood Guide — Streets and Pockets
item.description:
Mount Waverley isn’t one monolithic block. Like most Melbourne suburbs, it has different pockets with different personalities. Here’s how to read the suburb from the inside.

See our full Mount Waverley suburb guide for the overview.

Mount Waverley Isn’t Just One Thing

Walk from one end of Mount Waverley to the other and you’ll notice the vibe shift. The main commercial strip has one energy. The residential streets behind it have another. And the edges of the suburb — where it bleeds into Glen Waverley — have their own thing going on.
